refutedReason: The quote is real (TxCopyButton.vue:59-60) but the cited code refutes the stated mechanism. The only residual leak needs the extra assumption that execCommand itself throws (or select() throws), which is not what the summary describes and is not the normal browser behaviour for a failed copy; the fallback path is not even exercised by the tests (copy-button.test.ts always stubs navigator.clipboard).
